title: Introduction to Estate Planning
description: A foundational exploration of estate planning instruments and strategies—wills, trusts, beneficiary designations, powers of attorney, healthcare directives, and probate—equipping young adults with knowledge to protect themselves, their families, and their financial legacies.
learning_objectives: Define essential estate planning documents: wills, trusts, power of attorney, and healthcare directives
Explain the probate process and strategies for avoiding or minimizing it
Compare revocable and irrevocable trusts and understand when each is appropriate
Analyze how beneficiary designations interact with wills and why they're critical
Evaluate guardianship designations and their importance for families with minor children
Make informed decisions about basic estate planning needs appropriate for your life stage

skill_builder.title: Estate Planning Starter Checklist
skill_builder.description: A systematic framework for young adults to assess their current estate planning needs, identify priority documents, and create an action plan for protecting themselves and their families.
